note: Proposed expansion of seed/companies.json from 60 to 200, weighted toward enterprise-tier and EU-headquartered B2B SaaS. Every URL here is a candidate written from knowledge and has NOT been checked. Nothing enters seed/companies.json until `node scripts/check-seed.js --live` returns usable HTML for it and a human has confirmed the page is what the slug says it is. `pricing_url` is omitted where no public pricing page is believed to exist; that omission is itself a claim and needs the same confirmation as a URL. The `tier` field is a review annotation for auditing the weighting and must NOT be carried into the seed: it is a sourced judgement, not a crawled fact, and E5 was cut for exactly that reason.
segments_new_note: 16 segments the current taxonomy does not cover. METHODOLOGY v1.5 folds 14 segments into 5 groups; that fold was designed around the old taxonomy and must be redone before any segment cut is published against this corpus.

verification.origin_caveat: This run egressed from Germany.
